summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by International General Insurance Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release of Q2 and H1 2026 unaudited financial results and declaration of an ordinary common share dividend. The release reports net income, premiums, combined ratio, and book value per share, plus a dividend declaration and $72.9 million returned to shareholders. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or restructuring is present. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
